openPullRequests.head: auto-update-selenium-grid-versions
openPullRequests.title: Update Selenium Grid Docker images to latest stable versions

src/main/resources/docker-compose/seleni.content:
# Selenium Grid 4 for the engine tests (synthetic fixture, shaped like the real file but not copied from it).
# Browser nodes join the hub below; keep every image on the same dated release.
services:
  selenium-hub:
    image: selenium/hub:4.34.0-20250803
    container_name: selenium-hub
    ports:
      - "4442:4442"
      - "4443:4443"
      - "4444:4444"
  chrome:
    image: selenium/node-chrome:4.34.0-20250803
    shm_size: 2gb
    depends_on:
      - selenium-hub
    environment:
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_HOST=selenium-hub
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_PUBLISH_PORT=4442
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_SUBSCRIBE_PORT=4443
  edge:
    image: selenium/node-edge:4.34.0-20250803
    shm_size: 2gb
    depends_on:
      - selenium-hub
    environment:
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_HOST=selenium-hub
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_PUBLISH_PORT=4442
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_SUBSCRIBE_PORT=4443
  firefox:
    image: selenium/node-firefox:4.34.0-20250803
    shm_size: 2gb
    depends_on:
      - selenium-hub
    environment:
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_HOST=selenium-hub
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_PUBLISH_PORT=4442
      - SE_EVENT_BUS_SUBSCRIBE_PORT=4443
